My dear [Miss Smith](/person/263),

I hope you and the Incurable List are safe together somewhere![^2] I had no list of my own so I asked a friend to send you hers, and owing to some blundering of mine I really do not know whether she sent it to Wilden manor or to Charlton.

Will you kindly when you have looked it over return it addressed

[Miss Jacob](/person/749)
Crawley Rectory
Winchester

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge


[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: The \'incurable list\' was evidently a list of candidates for admission to an asylum; perhaps either the [Home for Incurable and Infirm Women](/organisation/26) or the [Royal Hospital for Incurables](/organisation/37).
